caption: Select the paper DOI column of a local notice list.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['retraction-review-queue']; p.settings.checked = {}; await p.saveSettings(); p.pro.signOut(); p.openReview(); const m = p.modal; await m.ready; await m.run(async () => { await m.load('Retraction Review Queue/notices.csv'); }); return 'ok'; })()

caption: The queue shows two supplied notices and affected notes.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['retraction-review-queue']; p.openReview(); const m = p.modal; await m.ready; await m.run(async () => { await m.load('Retraction Review Queue/notices.csv'); }); await m.run(() => m.scan()); if (m.queue.items.length !== 8) throw new Error('Sample links not ready: '+m.queue.items.length); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Read the title and fields supplied in the notice row.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['retraction-review-queue']; p.openReview(); const m = p.modal; await m.ready; await m.run(async () => { await m.load('Retraction Review Queue/notices.csv'); }); await m.run(() => m.scan()); if (m.queue.items.length !== 8) throw new Error('Sample links not ready: '+m.queue.items.length);m.contentEl.querySelector('details').open = true; m.contentEl.querySelector('details').scrollIntoView(); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Keep a checked state for one affected note and notice.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['retraction-review-queue']; p.openReview(); const m = p.modal; await m.ready; await m.run(async () => { await m.load('Retraction Review Queue/notices.csv'); }); await m.run(() => m.scan()); if (m.queue.items.length !== 8) throw new Error('Sample links not ready: '+m.queue.items.length);await p.mark(m.queue.items[0].id, true); await m.run(() => m.scan()); m.contentEl.querySelector('.rrq-list').scrollIntoView(); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Save a separate column map for this notice list with Pro.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['retraction-review-queue']; p.openReview(); const m = p.modal; await m.ready; await m.run(async () => { await m.load('Retraction Review Queue/notices.csv'); }); await m.run(() => m.scan()); if (m.queue.items.length !== 8) throw new Error('Sample links not ready: '+m.queue.items.length);p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('retraction-review-queue-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow();await p.saveMap(m.path, m.map); m.draw(); return 'ok'; })()

caption: The dated report is a local JSON snapshot.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['retraction-review-queue']; p.openReview(); const m = p.modal; await m.ready; await m.run(async () => { await m.load('Retraction Review Queue/notices.csv'); }); await m.run(() => m.scan()); if (m.queue.items.length !== 8) throw new Error('Sample links not ready: '+m.queue.items.length);p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('retraction-review-queue-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow();const path = await p.exportReport(m.queue, m.path, m.fileDate); window.__rrqReport = path; m.reportPath = path; m.reportText = await app.vault.adapter.read(path); m.draw(); m.contentEl.querySelector('.rrq-report').scrollIntoView(); return 'ok'; })()
after: (async () => { const f = app.vault.getFileByPath(window.__rrqReport); if(f) await app.vault.delete(f); app.plugins.plugins['retraction-review-queue'].pro.signOut(); return 'ok'; })()
